title: General review
body: Google calendar is great and I’ve been using it for nearly 2 years now. I’ve been using it to organise tasks organise my days and weeks as it is very very useful. The only thing I would say about the app is that there are a lot of bugs to be fixed and events can sometimes be all over the place when you’re trying to edit it apart from that it’s a great app. Some problems I have include when I’m trying to switch events to a different time it lags a lot and won’t allow me sometimes, when I duplicate events sometimes it appears on a day like 2 months prior, and also just general lagging when organising. Great app however, I don’t think I’ll ever switch from it 👍
